LABOUR.TITLE: Labor Law
LABOUR.SUBTITLE: Legal regulations and labor relations within the Mexican legal framework. Includes laws, regulations, and judicial precedents related to employment contracts, labor unions, social security, minimum wages, working conditions, and workers' rights.

PENAL.TITLE: Criminal Procedural Law
PENAL.SUBTITLE: Legal procedures in criminal cases under the Mexican jurisdiction. Covers the judicial process from initial investigation to trial and sentencing, including constitutional guarantees, investigation procedures, prosecution, defense, evidence, legal remedies, and penalty enforcement.

FISCAL.TITLE: Tax Law
FISCAL.SUBTITLE: Applicable tax laws and regulations in Mexico, covering federal, state, and municipal taxes. Includes regulations on income tax, value-added tax (VAT), business taxes, customs, tax audit procedures, tax compliance, and administrative and judicial remedies.

CIVIL.TITLE: Civil and Commercial Law
CIVIL.SUBTITLE: Legal regulations related to civil and commercial law in Mexico. This includes civil and commercial contracts, property, successions, contractual obligations and liabilities, as well as commercial disputes, company regulations, and bankruptcy procedures.

CORPORATE.TITLE: Corporate and Business Law
CORPORATE.SUBTITLE: Legal aspects of companies and corporations in Mexico. This encompasses company formation, corporate structures, corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, commercial contracts, investment protection, intellectual property, competition law, compliance, and corporate social responsibility.

FAMILY.TITLE: Family Law
FAMILY.SUBTITLE: Mexican legislation related to family and succession matters. This includes marriage, divorce, parental authority, custody, alimony, filiation, adoption, guardianship, successions, wills, and family procedures, as well as rights and protection of minors and vulnerable groups.

SERVICES.TITLE: Legal Services
SERVICES.SUBTITLE: Whether you need legal advice, representation, or document preparation, we are committed to protecting your rights and achieving the best possible outcome for your case.
SERVICES.BUTTON.LABEL: See more
SERVICES.DESCRIPTION.CARD.ANALIZE: Our legal team carefully reviews your case, examining all relevant documents, evidence, and legal precedents. We assess the strengths and challenges, providing you with a clear understanding of your legal position and potential outcomes.
SERVICES.DESCRIPTION.CARD.STEPS: Once we establish a strategy, we take decisive action—whether it’s negotiations, legal filings, or gathering additional evidence. We keep you informed at every step, ensuring a smooth and well-prepared approach to resolving your case.
SERVICES.DESCRIPTION.CARD.SUCCESS: If your case goes to court, our skilled attorneys provide strong representation, advocating for your rights with compelling arguments and evidence. Our goal is to secure the best possible outcome, ensuring justice is served in your favor.

LIST.PAGE.TITLE: Servicios
LIST.PAGE.SUBTITLE: Servicios de Asesoría Jurídica en México Distrito Federal y Estado de México
LIST.PAGE.DESCRIPTION: Nuestro equipo de abogados cuenta con conocimientos profundos en las distintas ramas del derecho, por lo que podemos brindarle a usted servicios legales de alta calidad, de forma oportuna, transparente y eficaz, para asuntos en materia familiar, civil, penal, laboral, mercantil, laboral, administrativa y juicios de amparo.

FAMILY.TITLE: Family Law Services
FAMILY.DESCRIPTION: The law includes certain rules and regulations that directly affect the formation, dissolution, and organization of the family unit. Our lawyers will use the current legal frameworks to help you resolve any legal conflict in family matters.

CIVIL.TITLE: Civil Law Services
CIVIL.DESCRIPTION: Relationships between individuals (whether voluntary or obligatory) generate interests that are governed by civil law. This specialized branch of our services is responsible for regulating and preserving the personal and property interests of individuals.

PENAL.TITLE: Criminal Law Services
PENAL.DESCRIPTION: This branch of our services is responsible for analyzing and utilizing the rules that regulate the determination of behaviors classified as crimes, as well as their investigation, prosecution, and penalties, to ensure the rights of victims and accused are respected.

LABOR.TITLE: Labor Law Services
LABOR.DESCRIPTION: This branch of our services is responsible for intervening and resolving all situations arising from labor relations, in accordance with the provisions of the Federal Labor Law or the Federal Law of Workers in the Service of the State, as the case may be.

COMMERCIAL.TITLE: Commercial Law Services
COMMERCIAL.DESCRIPTION: In this specialized branch of our services, a lawyer will be responsible for advising and resolving all legal aspects of your commercial activities (invoicing, collection, debts, commercial lawsuits), through the applicable legal provisions.

ADMINISTRATIVE.TITLE: Administrative Law Services
ADMINISTRATIVE.DESCRIPTION: A specialist will help you ensure that your activities (construction, modifications, opening businesses and establishments, etc.) comply with the requirements established by administrative laws.

AMPARO.TITLE: Amparo Trial
AMPARO.DESCRIPTION: Our lawyers will file amparo lawsuits to exercise your constitutional rights and protect you against possible abuses or damages caused by regulations, sanctions, laws, acts, or omissions by public authorities.

ABOUT.TITLE: About Us
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: At ABG Abogados, we are a team of highly experienced legal professionals dedicated to providing top-tier legal services in Mexico. With over 30 years of expertise, our lawyers specialize in a wide range of legal fields, including corporate law, civil litigation, family law, criminal defense, real estate, and more.
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION.INFO: Our commitment is to deliver strategic, effective, and personalized legal solutions tailored to the needs of our clients. Whether representing individuals, businesses, or institutions, we uphold the highest standards of professionalism, integrity, and excellence.
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION.INFO.NEXT: With a deep understanding of Mexican law and a results-driven approach, we strive to protect your rights and achieve the best possible outcomes. Contact us today and let our expertise work for you.
